snippet.title: Echoes of the Stars | Official 4K | Showcase Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Echoes of the Stars is a hand-painted action JRPG where rebellion, myth, and emotion collide.

Watch the official 4K showcase trailer featured in the 2025 JRPG Indie Quest Showcase.


Wishlist now on Steam:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767010/Echoes_of_the_Stars/


💫 Explore a vast, voice-acted world
⚔️ Dynamic action combat with character switching and build systems
🎨 Beautifully animated 2D world with reactive portraits and environments
🎶 Original soundtrack inspired by classic RPGs
🛠️ Dozens of mini-games, cities, ships, and secrets to uncover

Follow development and join the journey:
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alchimiastudios
🐦 Twitter/X: https://x.com/AlchimiaStudios
🌐 Website: https://alchimiastudios.com

#EchoesOfTheStars #JRPG #IndieGame #ShowcaseTrailer #IndieQuest
